name: Hannō (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Hannō city emblem in red: a ring with four pointed spokes enclosing a ring with a disc.
history: Municipal flag of Hannō, a city in Saitama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 5 December 1922.

features.role: Hannō city emblem — a ring with four pointed spokes enclosing a ring with a disc
